categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches src/interfaces/wallet.h only to expose transaction eligibility checks to the GUI, which the category explicitly excludes when interface mechanics are not the point.
categories.rationale: Non-member: adding a method to interfaces::Wallet to support wallet/GUI functionality is not an IPC PR.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Implements a new wallet RPC rebroadcastwallettx, exposes wallet rebroadcast eligibility logic, and adds a GUI context menu action.
categories.rationale: Adds a direct RPC and GUI mechanism for users to rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions without manual hex extraction. As noted in the description, 'there needs to be a way for users to rebroadcast a transaction' without having to resort to getting the hex and calling sendrawtransaction; this is a clear user-facing improvement that remains reasonably deferrable.
